# VRHands

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/view/systems/`](../folders/src-view-systems.md)
> **Source:** [`src/view/systems/vr_control.cpp`](../../../src/view/systems/vr_control.cpp)

## Summary

The two host entities drawing (and colliding as) the VR controllers.

## Description

Anonymous-namespace struct in vr_control.cpp, emplaced by VRControlSys::preinit. Filled in VRControlSys::init only when VRInput exists and is enabled and resources/models/box.gltf loads; each hand is then an entity with Transform (scale 0), ModelRenderable (box, blue left / red right) and a kinematic RigidBody of half extent 0.04. Not reachable from other translation units.
